title: Why the Stargazers left
summary: The Stargazers’ case for the other Fera.

claims.text: Stargazers who have left the Garou Nation say the West gave up on them as much as the reverse: they hold that the war cannot be won without Bastet, Corax, Kitsune, Gurahl and the other Fera, whom the Western tribes have driven away.
Stargazers feel a kinship with the Bagheera werepanthers, since both favour careful thought over open war.
